content.title: Closed-root warm entries and original-source boundary atoms verified
content.text:
[2026-11-17 14:45 CET] Source f3bdcdf608555234d835bfe8bf06f96d9162ddb6 adds eight public theorems and one private theorem. All five publication gates passed: public 668, fresh strict 9, independent 263, Audit build 668, Audit strict 668. No diagnostics, sorryAx, or nonstandard axioms. All 6329 pins were reverified. The nine fresh reports are separate from 452 inherited reports. No old report is replaced; all 264 resource-owner reports remain inherited.

The physical closed-root factor and five existing-owner wrappers derive AuthenticEntryAt for the actual staged child without a fabricated second pending slot. This gives physical entry facts. MixedQualified Profile, height, orientation, and the source-qualified history of every retained cell remain open.

The original-source cold-query theorem classifies every boundary atom of every closed Available value at the literal execute outcome and every bounded Trace endpoint as the original U identity. It explicitly requires the actual initial heap to equal the authentic source heap. It derives initial Ready, physical validity, and NoNewMu internally. It retains the original query inputs and fuels. No future OnlyU, Profile, Result, body, or model supplier is used. A Marker can have no boundary atoms; this classification does not prove inhabitance or Type/Marker compatibility.

Six old owners retain their full bytes as prefixes with no new imports; 6243 other old non-Audit sources are exact. All old proof limits and bodies remain. No Haskell changed or new reachable defect was established. One compatible finite completion of the same original emitted root and all causal historical obligations remains open. Compiled Haskell correspondence remains separate.

All proof jobs are terminal. Cleanup removed 17213792 bytes of owned terminal objects; the latest /tmp census was 3185173995 readable bytes. Sources, logs, unknown files, and normal .lake remain. The verified checkpoint is being assembled before the authorized origin/formalize push.
